description: Search Google Patents for inventions, patent titles and publication links. Required: query.

after.description: Publication start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; omitted means no cutoff. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

assignee.description: Assignee name filter; omitted means any assignee. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

before.description: Publication cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD format; omitted means no cutoff. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

country.description: Patent country code; omitted means any country. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

inventor.description: Inventor name filter; omitted means any inventor. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

language.description: Result language code; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

num.description: Result count, integer 1-100; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

page.description: Result page, integer at least 1; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required patent search keywords; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

sort.description: Sort order: new or old; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

status.description: Patent status filter; omitted uses source default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_patents
title: Google Patents
